question: A Team-plan owner shares a project organisation-wide so that more colleagues can benefit from the documents it contains. What is the greatest concern?
options: A) Everyone in the organisation gains access to knowledge that may include restricted or confidential material.
B) Organisation-wide sharing converts the project's documents into training data for future Claude models.
C) The original owner loses the ability to edit the project once it is visible to the whole organisation.
D) Sharing removes the project's instructions, so the shared version behaves differently for everyone who opens it.
correct_answers: A) Everyone in the organisation gains access to knowledge that may include restricted or confidential material.
explanations: Correct. Broadening a project's audience broadens access to every document already uploaded into it.
How a project is shared has no bearing on model training.
The owner keeps their access when a project is shared more widely.
Sharing does not strip a project's instructions.
